calls.title: Thoughts and feedback on titles, companies and messages for prospecting
calls.summary: The meeting addressed multiple strategies to support Customer IO, which faces internal challenges due to a lack of expertise in experimentation. A focused team is offering guidance to help their program succeed, while efforts are being made to secure executive sponsorship to address resource gaps. Furthermore, the team is refining its podcast guest selection process to target director-level roles in high-traffic companies, aiming for better demo conversion rates. Outbound messaging is being optimized as current email campaigns show moderate engagement, necessitating refined messaging for improved bookings. The overall goal is to clarify Growth Book’s role as a specialized experimentation tool, avoiding the pitfalls of becoming a broad platform.
calls.keywords: Customer IO, experimentation, podcast targeting, outbound messaging, prospect profiling, Sales Navigator
